question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

A gift from my teacher on the eve of the new year was __a complete surprise__.

options.text: like a cat on hot bricks

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"a bolt from the blue"** means** a sudden and unexpected event or piece of news.** (आकस्मिक घटना या समाचार)

 
 
• **Example:** The news of his resignation came as a bolt from the blue.
 
 
 
• **"A gift from my teacher on the eve of the new year was a complete surprise."** This sentence suggests that the gift was unexpected and sudden.
 
 
• **Example:** The sudden announcement of the bonus was a bolt from the blue for all the employees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **a bolt from the blue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Like a cat on hot bricks** (बेचैन): Extremely nervous or restless.

 
 
• **Example:** She was **like a cat on hot bricks **waiting for the exam results.
 
 
 
• **Like striking one’s colours** (हार मानना): To surrender or give up.
 
 
• **Example:** After a long debate, he finally **struck his colours** and agreed to the terms.
 
 
 
• **Spilling of beans** (राज़ खोलना): To reveal a secret.
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally** spilled the beans **about the surprise party.
